request-prompt: In the 'Trending' section, increase the spacing between news items and enlarge the thumbnail images to make the feed feel more spacious and visual.
goal: I prefer spacious, visual layouts with large images and preview text that make the browsing experience feel engaging and less overwhelming.
jobs: I want to catch up on the latest news and trending stories to stay informed.
I want to search the web to find information on a specific topic.
I want to access my personal inbox to read and send emails.
I want to check my daily horoscope to see what the day has in store for me.
I want to check how the stock market is performing today.
I want to browse recommended retail products and find active shopping deals.
I want to find out which shows or movies are currently recommended to watch.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer using an all-in-one web portal that aggregates news, weather, email, and entertainment so I don't have to visit multiple different websites.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer visiting dedicated, specialized websites for my news, weather, and email separately to avoid cluttered interfaces and stay focused.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer highly condensed, text-heavy list layouts with minimal images so I can scan a large volume of headlines as quickly as possible.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer spacious, visual layouts with large images and preview text that make the browsing experience feel engaging and less overwhelming.

preference-pairs.a: I welcome sponsored content, product deals, and algorithmic recommendations because they often introduce me to new products and topics I wouldn't have discovered on my own.
preference-pairs.b: I actively ignore or block sponsored links, ads, and shopping recommendations, preferring to consume strictly organic news and utility-focused information.
